task.prompt: Read slide slideDev01 in the private synthetic presentation presSlidesDev01 and identify its visible text. Preserve the entire source deck, including its text, native element identities and image. Do not edit, recreate, upload, share or change permissions. Return JSON with exactly presentation_id, slide_id and text. The presentation contains one slide; do not include XML markup in text.

slide.content: Launch 你好
Launch 你好

xml_presentation.content: Launch 你好
Launch 你好

limitations: This bounded response table instantiates the predeclared Launch 你好 text and fixture-image native slide only. It does not emulate Slides writes, native rendering, OCR, media download/upload, history, wiki resolution or pagination.

Both current and explicitly pinned revision 7 return the one complete fixture page. Other declared revision values reject. A page read requires slideDev01 or page number 1; the companion selector, when present, must name the same page. Missing selectors never silently select a target. The shortcut itself rejects dual selectors, while this static table can safely represent matching selectors on equivalent raw reads.

Full-deck reads accept absent/false remove_attr_id with native XML IDs, and true with a separate response-only ID-stripped variant. The native fixture source remains unchanged; no XML rewrite or mutation is exposed. Page reads do not support removing IDs.

The shared signed adapter must independently observe at least one successful slide_get or presentation_get, validate the typed exact final answer, detect rejected requests/config changes and never trust agent-authored receipts. Identity, help or schema alone cannot prove the page was read.

The response table contains immutable native page/text/image-token/element-ID state. No route can change that state and no outbound forwarding exists. The reviewed contract additionally pins real fixture PNG bytes and SHA-256; this static runtime does not implement a mutable deck/media store, so it cannot independently demonstrate persisted live image bytes, backend ACLs or revision concurrency.

No screenshot/render response is invented: XML data includes the real text node and native img src token only. The deterministic fixture PNG is not an image containing the slide text. Screenshot/render routes are absent and the common verifier treats rejected requests as unsuccessful task evidence; this limitation must be kept visible when interpreting strategy coverage.

Unknown query keys follow the common static-table policy. Every supported content-affecting selector (revision, page ID/number and presentation remove_attr_id) is explicitly constrained or represented by a response variant. This is not evidence for arbitrary backend query behavior.

The model-facing fixture contains only scenario and type schema; all exact text values, API content and expectations are held out of that fixture schema. The prompt exposes only requested target IDs. No model trials or held-out evaluations were run for this normalization.
